meta.basis: Base case, plan of record (plan/strategy.md sections 2, 6, 13; data/plan.json kpis)
meta.labels: [A] assumption, [E] estimate, [U] unverified; targets without a label come from the master plan
meta.weeklyTargetsNote: visits, paid (gross new paying accounts), activated payers, active subs, MRR, loop share and CAC come from data/plan.json. signups = visits x 5% (base signupRate in data/funnel.json). creatorsActive = creators who posted at least one tracked video that week (paid, affiliate or Content Rewards) [E].
meta.sources: Each funnel stage names one source of truth: cookieless counter, UTM (/go/ redirect log), app DB, Whop, or platform analytics.

northStar.name: Weekly activated payers
northStar.definition: Net new paying accounts (after refunds) that sent at least one client review link, or published or exported a deck or book, within 7 days of paying
northStar.baseTarget: ~13-27 a week in November (13, 18, 20, 27 in weeks 2-5) rising to ~27-33 a week in January (60% of weekly net payers in weeks 1-4, 70% after)
guardrails: Refunds within 14 days <=15% (brake at 20% per source)
First build started within 10 minutes for >=80% of payers in week 1, >=90% from week 2

funnelStages.name: Reach
funnelStages.definition: Views of owned posts, creator posts, boosts and Content Rewards videos in the week.
funnelStages.target: Owned: 25-30 posts a week (12-15 in weeks 9-10); house formats >= 3x the account median views. Paid creators base ~6,000 views per post [A]

funnelStages.name: Intent
funnelStages.definition: /go/ short-link clicks plus Instagram keyword DMs (SITE, DECK, BOOK, CLIENT) per 1,000 views.
funnelStages.target: 3-8 per 1,000 views (strategy.md 13); DM replies >= 3 per 1,000 Instagram views

funnelStages.name: Qualified visit
funnelStages.definition: A makeborne.com page view that is not a bot, not internal and lands on a public page; counted as a daily aggregate with utm_* and an allow-listed referrer host.

funnelStages.name: Brief typed
funnelStages.definition: Visitor presses Create with a brief on a public page (anonymous aggregate, no brief text stored in analytics).

funnelStages.name: Account created
funnelStages.definition: A new Makeborne account, with first touch (source, medium, campaign, content, aff/ref code flags) stored on the account.

funnelStages.name: Checkout opened
funnelStages.definition: Makeborne creates a Whop checkout for a signed-in account, with mb_src, mb_campaign, mb_aff in metadata.
funnelStages.target: 60% of new accounts (base) [A], i.e. 3% of qualified visits open a checkout [A]; stretch: >= 8% of /go/ format-page landings, format pages only, once they ship

funnelStages.name: Paid
funnelStages.definition: First successful payment on a Makeborne-created checkout; gross until 14 days pass.
funnelStages.target: 1.0% of qualified visits within 30 days (base); 33% of opened checkouts [A]; 500 gross over 13 weeks

funnelStages.name: First build
funnelStages.definition: First AI build started after payment; minutes from payment recorded.
funnelStages.target: >= 80% within 10 minutes of paying in week 1; >= 90% within 10 minutes from week 2

funnelStages.name: Activated payer (north star)
funnelStages.event: review_link_created / site_published (format deck or book) / export_downloaded (deck or book) within 7 days of paying
funnelStages.definition: Net (not refunded) payer who sent a client review link, or published or exported a deck or book, within 7 days of paying.
funnelStages.target: 60% of net payers in weeks 1-4, 70% after

funnelStages.name: Refund
funnelStages.definition: Refund of a first payment within 14 days.

funnelStages.name: Renewal
funnelStages.event: subscription_renewed (second successful payment on the same membership)
funnelStages.definition: Month-2 renewal of a monthly subscriber.
funnelStages.target: >= 90% month-2 renewal (base; the model uses 10% monthly churn) [A]; alert below 85%; 70% is a kill-review floor only, not a target

funnelStages.name: Loop-sourced payer
funnelStages.event: subscription_started with first touch utm_medium=product_loop or referral
funnelStages.definition: New payer whose first touch is the review page, badge, deck/book share link or a customer referral.
funnelStages.target: 0% week 1 rising to 20% of new payers by week 13 (base)

alerts.metric: Whop payment with no matching Makeborne checkout (store-page or tracking-link purchase)
alerts.action: Same day: grant credits manually, find the link that leaked, replace it with a /go/ link. Never hand out Whop store or tracking links.

alerts.metric: Purchases with a known source (attribution coverage)
alerts.action: Freeze new creator payments and boosts until fixed; push the 'How did you hear about us?' answers into the report; report 'unknown' honestly.

alerts.metric: Attribution plumbing (/go/, first touch, checkout metadata) live
alerts.action: Ship the onboarding survey fallback; hold every paid line except TAAFT.
Read every refund reason; check copy for overclaims; review first-build failures; consider D1 earlier.
Pause the source (refund brake); re-brief or drop the creator.

alerts.threshold: >= 1 in a day, or >= 3 in a week [A]
alerts.action: Answer each the same day; pause paid pushes at 3 a week; refund proactively when a buyer is unhappy. Card-network dispute thresholds are unverified [U].

alerts.metric: First build started within 10 minutes of paying
alerts.action: Raise the AI daily limit now (D6); show the honest queue message; contact stalled payers personally.

alerts.threshold: any hit on a day with new payers
alerts.action: Raise the limit to at least new payers x 2 builds x $1.35; check before every creator post and beat.
Founder joins support; cut X replies first, then long YouTube.

alerts.metric: Paid source spend with no net payers
alerts.action: Kill the source.
Stop the boost.
Apply D4: reinvest 30% at <= $50, 10% at $50-62.50, 0% above $62.50; never exceed the $120 hard ceiling on any source.

alerts.threshold: no source with net payers at <= $50 CAC, or /go/ visit-to-paid < 0.7%
alerts.action: Change the offer before buying more views: owner decisions D1 (usage-capped refund) and D2 (capped preview).

alerts.metric: Cumulative gross paid on Sun 22 Nov
alerts.action: Low band: protect margin, no reinvestment growth. Base: plan as written. >= 300: breakout path live, raise reinvestment, prepare AI capacity.

alerts.threshold: < 80% of target two Sundays in a row
alerts.action: Re-forecast low/base/high from real rates in data/funnel.json; cut the bottom-half formats.
Re-cut with 2 new hooks; check the boost qualification; re-post natively on the other surfaces.

alerts.metric: Instagram DM keyword replies per 1,000 views
alerts.action: Fix the CTA wording and the DM content; test a different keyword.
Inspect Whop checkout for card/FX failures and tax display; check that price and refund line match the plan page.

alerts.metric: Promotion of a feature that is not live
alerts.threshold: any post, brief, DM or page
alerts.action: Take it down or relabel 'coming soon' with no date; features are only promoted after their beat:<feature> passes the gate.

alerts.metric: Ad pixel, retargeting tag or device-stored referral cookie on makeborne.com
alerts.threshold: present before the consent banner is live
alerts.action: Remove it the same day; consent banner (CMP) first.
